//: NOT the project config — that is web/tsconfig.json (20-repo-restructure US-2).
This shim exists because `tsx` resolves path aliases from the nearest
tsconfig.json at or above its cwd, and the still-TypeScript entry points
(server/, scripts/) run from the repo root. Without it `npm run dev` and
every `tsx scripts/*.ts` fail to resolve @contracts/* at runtime.
The baseUrl/paths below are stated explicitly (not inherited) so they are
correct from HERE; keep them in sync with web/tsconfig.json's.
